meta.title: AidoPost — Turn phone photos into scroll-stopping product posts
meta.description: Upload 2–3 photos of your product, pick a style, and get social-media-ready professional photos in under a minute. Your product stays exactly as it is.

hero.badge: New · AI product photography for small brands
hero.subtitle: Upload 2–3 photos of one product, choose a style, and AidoPost stages it in a professional scene — without changing a single detail of your product.
hero.sliderLabel: Drag to compare the phone photo with the AidoPost result
hero.proof1: Your product, untouched — only the scene changes
hero.proof3: No photographer. No studio. No editing skills.
hero.beforeAlt: Phone photo of an enamel silver signet ring held between fingers
hero.afterAlt: The same ring staged by AidoPost on black marble with studio lighting

how.title: Three steps. Under a minute.
how.s1text: Tell us what you do — or just paste your website or Instagram and we'll write it for you.
how.s2text: Add 2–3 photos of the same product from different angles. Plain background, good light.
how.s3text: Pick Minimalist, Casual or Premium and get 3 different pro shots, ready for your feed.

benefits.title: Built for people who sell, not people who edit.
benefits.exactText: Shape, colours, logos and labels are preserved. We only build the scene around it.
benefits.langText: English, Armenian, Arabic, German, Turkish, Swedish and Spanish — including full right-to-left.
benefits.variantsText: Hero shot, lifestyle and editorial — three different concepts from one upload.
benefits.sizesText: Square, portrait 4:5 and story 9:16, in HD or Ultra HD.
benefits.speedText: Your first photo arrives before your coffee cools down.
benefits.brandText: Save your brand once and every future shoot matches your style.

pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade when you're hooked.
pricing.notes: Unused monthly generations don't roll over. Need more? Top up 20 generations for $5. Or buy a single clean HD image for $5 — no subscription.
pricing.vat: Prices in USD. VAT may apply.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.a1: No. Every image is generated with strict instructions to keep your product exactly as it appears in your photos — shape, colours, materials, logos and text. Only the background, props, lighting and composition are created.
faq.a2: 2–3 photos of the same item from different angles, in good light, ideally on a plain background. Different products in one upload won't work — we'll let you know.
faq.q3: How many images do I get per product?
faq.a3: Each combination of brand, photos and style gives you 3 different concepts: a hero shot, a lifestyle scene and an editorial look. Each one uses 1 credit.
faq.q4: Can I use the images commercially?
faq.a4: Yes, on Lite and Pro, and for any HD image you buy individually. Free-trial images are for personal evaluation.
faq.a5: The website and studio work in English, Armenian, Arabic, German, Turkish, Swedish and Spanish. Your brand description is written in the language you're using.
faq.a6: Yes. Manage or cancel your subscription anytime from the billing portal; you keep access until the end of the paid period.
